title: My Daughter-in-Law Threw My 75th Birthday Cake in the Trash. She Didn't Know What Was in My Purse.
description:
On my 75th birthday, my daughter-in-law scraped my cake into the trash in front of the whole family and told me nobody wanted me there past Christmas. She had no idea what was folded inside my purse.

Stay until Thanksgiving dinner. That's when I finally stood up and tapped my glass.
